cartridge_mod.configuration.spectatorRad: Players this close to a TV showing a game see and hear it, and run the emulator for it. Lower it if spectators' computers struggle.
cartridge_mod.configuration.roms.tooltip: Limits on games and BIOS files burned in the Cartridge Writer.
cartridge_mod.configuration.maxRomSizeMe: The largest file a player may burn onto a cartridge. NES games are well under 1 MB.
cartridge_mod.configuration.romStorageQu: Total space for all burned games on this server. Once full, new uploads are refused; nothing is deleted automatically.
cartridge_mod.configuration.uploadPermis: Who may burn games, upload a BIOS and import saves: 0 lets everyone, 2 only operators.
cartridge_mod.configuration.validateRomH: Refuse files that don't look like a game for the console, such as a renamed picture.
cartridge_mod.configuration.cables.toolt: How AV Cables link consoles to TVs.
cartridge_mod.configuration.cableRange.t: How far apart, in blocks, a console and a linked TV may be.
cartridge_mod.configuration.maxTvsPerCon: How many TVs one console can show its game on at once.
cartridge_mod.configuration.netplay.tool: How two-player games stay in step over the network.
cartridge_mod.configuration.rollbackFram: How far ahead (in frames, 60 a second) a player's game may run before waiting for the other player. Higher hides more lag but shows more corrections.
cartridge_mod.configuration.maxInputDela: On a slow connection, a player's own presses are held back by up to this many frames, so fewer corrections are needed. 0 never delays.
cartridge_mod.configuration.resumeSnapsh: How often a running game is saved on the server, so it carries on after everyone leaves, a crash or a restart.
cartridge_mod.configuration.lightGunRang: How far, in blocks, the Pixelon Blaster can hit a TV from.
cartridge_mod.configuration.playModeUnat: While you're playing, hear the game at full volume wherever you stand, instead of from the TV.
cartridge_mod.help.crt_tv.1: Link it to a console with an AV Cable to show its game.
cartridge_mod.help.crt_tv.2: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to unplug the cable.
cartridge_mod.help.flatscreen_tv.1: Link it to a console with an AV Cable. Place it on a block's side to hang it on the wall.
cartridge_mod.help.flatscreen_tv.2: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to unplug the cable.
cartridge_mod.help.large_flatscreen_tv.1: 3 blocks wide, 2 tall: the spot you click is its bottom middle. Place it on a block's side to hang it on the wall.
cartridge_mod.help.large_flatscreen_tv.2: Link it to a console with an AV Cable; sneak + right-click with an empty hand to unplug it.
cartridge_mod.help.display_panel.1: Panels side by side join into one big screen when they fill a rectangle (up to 8 x 6).
cartridge_mod.help.display_panel.2: One AV Cable into any panel feeds the whole wall.
cartridge_mod.help.display_panel.3: Sneak + right-click any panel with an empty hand to unplug the cable.
cartridge_mod.help.console_8bit.1: Insert a cartridge, link a TV with an AV Cable, then press POWER.
cartridge_mod.help.console_8bit.2: Plug a Pixelon Pad into a port, then right-click the pad to play.
cartridge_mod.help.console_8bit.3: Right-click the body for the cartridge and Memory Card slots.
cartridge_mod.help.cartridge_writer.1: Burns a game file from your computer onto a Blank Cartridge.
cartridge_mod.help.cartridge_writer.2: Also copies cartridges (not their saves) and erases them; Import and Export move saves as .sav files.
cartridge_mod.help.blank_cartridge.1: Burn a game onto it in the Cartridge Writer.
cartridge_mod.help.cartridge.1: Right-click a console to insert it.
cartridge_mod.help.cartridge.2: Its battery save stays with this cartridge.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_8bit.1: Right-click a Pixelon Entertainment System's port to plug it in.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_8bit.2: Right-click the plugged pad to play; press Esc to stop.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_8bit.3: Sneak + right-click its port with an empty hand to unplug it.
cartridge_mod.help.light_gun.1: Plugs into port 2 of a Pixelon Entertainment System, for light-gun games.
cartridge_mod.help.light_gun.2: Take it like a pad, aim at the TV and click to fire.
cartridge_mod.help.av_cable.1: Right-click a console, then a CRT TV, to link them.
cartridge_mod.help.av_cable.2: Sneak + right-click the air to cancel a link.
cartridge_mod.help.memory_card.1: Put it in a console's card slot to save the game's moment.
cartridge_mod.help.memory_card.2: Load it later into any cartridge of the same game.
cartridge_mod.configuration.enabled.tool: Read the gamepad while playing. Turn off if another mod handles your pad.
cartridge_mod.configuration.leftStickAsD: The left stick also presses the D-pad's directions.
cartridge_mod.configuration.client.toolt: Your own settings, on this computer.
cartridge_mod.configuration.server.toolt: Settings for worlds this game hosts (singleplayer and LAN). Saving sends them to everyone playing.
cartridge_mod.configuration.server.remot: You're on another server: its settings are in its config/cartridge_mod-server.json5.
cartridge_mod.configuration.general.tool: Who sees and hears a game.
cartridge_mod.console.controls.tooltip: This console's keys and gamepad buttons, in Cartridge's config.
cartridge_mod.controls.title: Controls
cartridge_mod.controls.title.tooltip: Keys and gamepad buttons, set apart for each console.
cartridge_mod.controls.general.tooltip: The gamepad, and the keys every console shares.
cartridge_mod.controls.binding.tooltip: Left box: the key. Click it, then press a key or click a mouse button. Right box: the gamepad. Click it, then press the button, trigger or stick direction on the pad; held inputs light up. Delete clears the box you're setting.
cartridge_mod.controls.pixelon.tooltip: The Pixelon Pad, and the Pixelon Blaster's trigger.
cartridge_mod.controls.super_pixelon.too: The Super Pixelon Pad, also for Game Boy games in the Pocketron Adapter.
cartridge_mod.controls.vortex_drive.tool: The 6-button Vortex Pad. 3-button games use A, B, C and Start.
cartridge_mod.controls.pixelon_64.toolti: The Pixelon 64 Pad. The stick's keys push it all the way; a gamepad's left stick is always the analog stick.
cartridge_mod.writer.restore.tooltip: Pick this game's file again. Only the exact same file works; the cartridge, its name and its save stay as they are.
cartridge_mod.writer.hint.restore: %s: the game file is missing from this server. Restore it, or drop the file here.
cartridge_mod.writer.error.not_same_game: That isn't this cartridge's game file (a different file or version)
cartridge_mod.wall.not_rectangle: Fill in the wall: panels make one screen as a full rectangle
cartridge_mod.wall.too_big: Too big: a wall can be at most %s x %s panels
cartridge_mod.console.wrong_port: That doesn't go in this port
cartridge_mod.tv.unknown_system: This cartridge's game (%s) runs on a console this version of Cartridge doesn't have
cartridge_mod.play.hint_mouse: Super Pixelon Mouse · %s: big view, where the mouse moves it · Esc: stop playing
cartridge_mod.help.console_16bit.1: Takes Super Pixelon cartridges: right-click it with one, or use its GUI.
cartridge_mod.help.console_16bit.2: POWER and RESET are the purple sliders on top; the ports are on the front.
cartridge_mod.help.console_16bit.3: Link it to a TV with an AV Cable.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_16bit.1: Right-click a Super Pixelon's port to plug it in.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_16bit.2: Right-click the plugged pad to play; Esc to stop.
cartridge_mod.help.mouse_16bit.1: Plugs into port 1 of a Super Pixelon, for mouse games such as paint programs.
cartridge_mod.help.mouse_16bit.2: While playing, open the big view: your mouse moves it there.
cartridge_mod.help.console_vortex.1: Takes Vortex Drive cartridges: right-click it with one, or use its GUI.
cartridge_mod.help.console_vortex.2: POWER is the slider on top at the front left, RESET the button on the right; the ports are on the front.
cartridge_mod.help.console_vortex.3: Link it to a TV with an AV Cable.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_vortex.1: Right-click a Vortex Drive's port to plug it in.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_vortex.2: Six buttons: C, B, A and Z, Y, X are your A, B, Y and R, X, L keys.
cartridge_mod.help.console_64.1: Takes Pixelon 64 cartridges: right-click it with one, or use its GUI.
cartridge_mod.help.console_64.2: RESET is the slider on top at the left, POWER the one on the right; four ports are on the front.
cartridge_mod.help.console_64.3: Link it to a TV with an AV Cable.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_64.1: Right-click a Pixelon 64's port to plug it in.
cartridge_mod.help.controller_64.2: WASD is the stick, Space A, Shift B, Left Ctrl Z, Q and E L and R, the arrows C, I J K L the D-pad.
cartridge_mod.handheld.no_cartridge: No cartridge in it: sneak + right-click to put one in
cartridge_mod.pocketron_adapter.fits: Pocketron cartridges, and ones that also play in color. Pocketron Color-only games don't run on it.
cartridge_mod.play.hint_walk: %s: play on your gamepad, walk as usual  ·  %s: big view  ·  Esc: stop playing
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron.1: Sneak + right-click it in hand to put in a cartridge and a Memory Card.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron.2: Right-click it in hand to switch it on and play. Esc or putting it away pauses it.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron.3: Plays Pocketron cartridges and the ones that also play in color.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_color.1: Sneak + right-click it in hand to put in a cartridge and a Memory Card.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_color.2: Right-click it in hand to switch it on and play. Esc or putting it away pauses it.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_color.3: Plays every Pocketron and Pocketron Color game. Craft it with a dye to recolor it.
cartridge_mod.handheld.no_offhand: Handhelds are held in the main hand
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_advance.1: Sneak + right-click it in hand to put in a cartridge and a Memory Card.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_advance.2: Right-click it in hand to switch it on and play. Esc or putting it away pauses it.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_advance.3: Plays Pocketron Advance cartridges. Craft it with a dye to recolor it.
Sneak + right-click it in hand to put in a cartridge and a Memory Card.

Plays Pocketron Advance cartridges. Craft it with a dye to recolor it.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_adapter.1: Right-click it in hand to put in a Pocketron cartridge.
cartridge_mod.help.pocketron_adapter.2: Then put it in a Super Pixelon to play the game on a TV, with Super Pixelon Pads.
cartridge_mod.configuration.pocketronPal: The original Pocketron's screen colors. Only you see your choice. Takes effect the next time a game starts.
cartridge_mod.configuration.handheldRang: Players this close to someone holding a running Pocketron see its screen and run the emulator for it.

cartridge_mod.link.no_cable: Put a Link Cable in the slot to link with someone
cartridge_mod.link.nobody: Nobody within %s blocks is holding a Pocketron
cartridge_mod.link.hold_yours: Hold your Pocketron to link it
cartridge_mod.link.too_far_to_ask: %s is too far away for the cable
cartridge_mod.link.asked: %s wants to link Pocketrons. Both games restart from power-on (battery saves are kept). %s %s
cartridge_mod.link.accept.hover: Link, and restart both games as one
cartridge_mod.link.linked: Linked: both Pocketrons restarted as one game
cartridge_mod.link.too_far: The link cable came out: you were too far apart
cartridge_mod.link.unlinked: Unlinked: each Pocketron restarts on its own
cartridge_mod.help.link_cable.1: Put it in a Pocketron's GUI (sneak + right-click), then Link with... a nearby player.
cartridge_mod.help.link_cable.2: Both games restart as one, for trading and two-player games. Stay within the cable's reach.
cartridge_mod.configuration.linkCableRan: How far apart two players with linked Pocketrons may be before the cable comes out.
